question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

The diver reached the **sea bed. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (bottom)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bed"** in this context refers to the bottom layer or surface of the sea, river, or any water body. (समुद्र/नदी का तल)

 
 
• **Example: **The archaeologists discovered ancient artifacts on the river bed.
 
 
 
• **"bottom" **is the correct synonym of "bed" in this context. It refers to the lowest part or surface of something, like the sea. (तल)
 
 
• **Example: **The shipwreck was found at the bottom of the ocean.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate homonym for "bed" in this sentence is **'bottom'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (bottom)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mattress **(गद्दा): A large, thick pad used for sleeping on.

 
 
• **Example:** She bought a new mattress for her bedroom.
 
 
 
• **Rest **(आराम): To relax or refresh oneself after exertion.
 
 
• **Example: **After a long day at work, I need some rest.
 
 
 
• **Chain** (जंजीर): A series of linked metal rings or connected items.
 
 
• **Example:** The chain on the bicycle broke while he was riding.
